title: Honua Sanitized Diagnostic Bundle (v1)
description: Canonical, sanitized evidence contract for SDK/client interop tickets (honua-support#41). A diagnostic bundle NEVER carries raw request/response bytes. Each captured HTTP exchange is a sanitized envelope: HTTP method, a normalized path (path parameters and query values placeholdered), status code, media type, correlation/trace ids, an allowlist of safe headers ONLY, and redacted + truncated body previews. For each body, the ORIGINAL byte size and a content hash are recorded alongside a redaction-applied flag so integrity is verifiable without the bytes. The bundle carries explicit content-classification and consent fields. Intake VALIDATES submissions against this schema and enforces every string-length, array-count, and body-size bound below; violations are rejected with a 400. This is the canonical artifact SDK emitters and the console must conform to.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Bump only on breaking changes; additive fields keep v1.

bundleId.description: Optional client-assigned id for the bundle. The server assigns its own id on intake.

contentClassification.description: Declared sensitivity of the captured content, after client-side redaction.

consent.description: Explicit consent to share the sanitized bundle with Honua support.

redactionAcknowledged.description: The submitter acknowledges the bundle was redacted and carries no raw secrets.

shareWithSupport.description: The submitter consents to sharing the sanitized bundle with Honua support.

grantedBy.description: Optional identity of the human/automation that granted consent.

envelopes.description: Sanitized HTTP exchanges. At least one; capped to bound bundle size.

normalizedPath.description: Request path with path parameters and query values placeholdered (e.g. /api/v1/tickets/{id}?status={value}).

statusCode.description: HTTP status code, when the exchange produced a response.

correlationId.description: Correlation id linking the exchange to server logs.

requestHeaders.description: Allowlisted, non-secret request headers ONLY. Authorization, Cookie, and any header not on the server allowlist are never present.

responseHeaders.description: Allowlisted, non-secret response headers ONLY. Set-Cookie and any header not on the server allowlist are never present.

bodyPreview.description: A redacted, truncated preview of a body plus integrity metadata for the ORIGINAL bytes. The raw bytes are never included.

preview.description: Redacted, truncated text preview of the body.

contentSha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the ORIGINAL (pre-redaction) body bytes.

originalByteSize.description: Size in bytes of the ORIGINAL body before truncation/redaction.

redactionApplied.description: True when redaction removed content from the preview.

truncated.description: True when the preview is shorter than the original body.
